'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Jan Westergard DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / In Complete Control]]
* '''Username:''' Ghosttrain
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
